title: Electrochemically Mediated Direct CO 2 Capture by a Stackable Bipolar Cell

compounds.name: poly(vinylanthraquinone)

conditions.quote: Three-electrode characterizations were performed in a BASi cell with Pt wire and Ag/AgCl (3 M NaCl) counter and reference electrodes, respectively. Experiments were performed with [BMIM][TFSI] electrolyte under both N2 and CO2 (saturated) conditions.
